anchor_scope: sanity-stack input budget and its lean procedure
anchor_statement: sanity-stack must take a budget input in its fenced JSON; in lean mode, or whenever GraphQL is unavailable, it must verify only that the PR base equals the recorded top and that the head descends from it with no divergence, using one filtered REST pull list and local git, and must make no GraphQL call.

cases.text: budget: lean: the subagent reads the recorded top, fetches, checks merge-base --is-ancestor, reads base.ref from the filtered REST list, appends the layer with linked false.
The subagent runs /sc-gh-stack-view or gh stack view --json in lean mode, or reads the raw 365 KB pull list into its context.

sanity-stack's fenced JSON input has a budget field. With budget lean, or when GraphQL is down, it only checks that the PR's base is the recorded top and that the head descends from it without divergence, using one filtered REST pull-request list and local git, and makes no GraphQL call.
